findings.title: Subgroup queries can still dereference a missing delegate
findings.body: The new null check handles `getSubGroupsCount`, but the subgroup-stream overloads at this line and lines 262 and 268 still call `modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` without checking for null. If a request obtains this cached adapter before a concurrent group deletion and resolves its delegate afterward, the supplier can return null—as this change explicitly anticipates—and a subgroup-list request still fails with an NPE and a server error.

findings.title: The concurrency test can pass before the reader reports failures
findings.body: The test starts the reader without waiting for it to issue a request, then sets `deletedAll` and asserts immediately without joining the thread. The reader may not run until after deletion, or an in-flight request may record its exception after the assertion, so the test can pass without detecting the regression. Also, if deletion throws before the flag is set, the non-daemon reader loops forever. Coordinate reader startup and ensure it is stopped and joined, including on failure.
